attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 20 Μαΐου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing, and carries no asterisk. None of the corpus's men of this name is a bishop of Brescia. `confessor` is used because the page says he contended stoutly against the Arian heretics and then that he fell asleep in peace; it does not call him a martyr. The page's whole entry is two sentences. No hymn.
